  status            string
                    Status is ok, branch_mismatch, or whichever freshness status stopped
                    it.
  flags             object
    pr_number       integer or null
    issue           integer or null
    worktree        boolean
    local_only      boolean
    no_autofix      boolean
  pr_exists         boolean
                    PRExists false is the ordinary degradation to a local review rather
                    than a failure. Everything else that goes wrong stops instead:
                    confusing the two would let a review of somebody else's work run
                    with this repository's own conventions and automatic fixing switched
                    on.
  head_ref          string or null
  context_path      string or null
  work_dir          string or null
                    WorkDir, ReviewPath and ThreadsPath are handed out rather than left
                    to the prompt; the binding is in reviewdir.go.
  review_path       string or null
  threads_path      string or null
  base_branch       string or null
  modes             object or null
    comment         boolean
                    Comment says the findings are posted as a review rather than acted
                    on, which is what reviewing somebody else's work means.
    personal_rules  boolean
                    PersonalRules says this repository's own conventions apply, which
                    they do to our own work and not to a stranger's.
    autofix         boolean
  freshness         object or null
                    Freshness is the whole report, so that a caller stopping on one can
                    say what it compared.
    status          string, one of: ok, synced, ahead_own, behind_dirty, diverged,
                    branch_mismatch, fetch_failed
    head_ref        string
    head_oid        string
    local_head      string
                    LocalHead is read after any synchronisation, so it is where the
                    checkout ended up rather than where it started.
  issues            array of object
    repo            string or null
                    Repo is null for an issue in this repository, which is how the body
                    wrote it.
    number          integer
  warnings          array of string
